abstract.t: This document defines the Session Identifier Option (SIO), carried as a TCP option for TCP connections and as a UDP option for UDP datagrams. The option lets the endpoints of a connection or flow publish identifiers at the transport layer, where network functions on the path - load balancers, NAT gateways, firewalls - can read them without per-flow state and without payload inspection. Network functions of all kinds can benefit from it: session recovery in load- balancing and NAT clusters, stateless forwarding, connection-tracking recovery, and telemetry. The option adds only a few octets, and only to the packets that carry it; which packets carry it is a deployment choice. Endpoints that do not support it behave as if the option did not exist.
